sources.summary: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash is Qwen's first multimodal model designed for AI agents. It processes audio and video together and independently uses tools to edit vlogs, translate clips, or summarize movies. On audio-video benchmarks, it nearly matches Gemini 3.8 Flash at a fraction of the API cost. The article Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash undercuts Google's Gemini Flash pricing while matching its multimodal benchmarks appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash 是 Qwen's 專為 AI 代理設計的首款多模態模型。它能同時處理語音和影片，並能獨立使用工具來編輯 vlog、翻譯剪輯短片或總結電影。在影音基準測試中，它的表現幾乎能媲美 Gemini 3.8 Flash，但 API 成本卻只需一小部分。這篇題為「Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash undercuts Google's Gemini Flash pricing while matching its multimodal benchmarks」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title: Google Deepmind 的 Dream-RSI 透過「做夢」回想過去的嘗試，幫助 AI 代理提升能力 / Google Deepmind's Dream-RSI helps AI agents improve by “dreaming” about past attempts
sources.title_zh: Google Deepmind 的 Dream-RSI 透過「做夢」回想過去的嘗試，幫助 AI 代理提升能力
sources.title_en: Google Deepmind's Dream-RSI helps AI agents improve by “dreaming” about past attempts
sources.title_original: Google Deepmind's Dream-RSI helps AI agents improve by “dreaming” about past attempts
sources.summary: Google and Deepmind's Dream-RSI lets AI agents "dream" through past search runs to test new strategies without costly recalculations. In tests, it matched or beat existing results, cutting iterations by a factor of up to 2.43. Only the search strategy adapts, while the underlying AI model stays unchanged. The article Google Deepmind's Dream-RSI helps AI agents improve by “dreaming” about past attempts appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google 與 Deepmind 的 Dream-RSI 讓 AI 代理能夠透過過去的搜尋執行過程來「做夢」，以測試新策略，而無需進行昂貴的重新計算。在測試中，它追平或超越了現有的結果，將迭代次數減少了最多 2.43 倍。只有搜尋策略會進行調整，而底層的 AI 模型則保持不變。這篇題為 Google Deepmind's Dream-RSI helps AI agents improve by “dreaming” about past attempts 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: In the spring of 2026, the U.S. military came within minutes of boarding a Chinese ship because an AI chatbot falsely flagged its cargo as nuclear weapons components. Armed soldiers were ready, aircraft were in the air. The error was caught just before the operation kicked off. The incident plays right into the hands of AI risk advocates who worry less about overpowered AI and more about sloppy systems being used by uncritical or bad-faith operators. sources.summary_zh: 在 2026 年春季，美軍差點在幾分鐘內登上一艘中國船隻，因為一個人工智慧聊天機器人錯誤地將其貨物標記為核武器組件。武裝士兵已蓄勢待發，軍機也在空中待命。這個錯誤在行動展開前夕才被發現。這起事件完全印證了人工智慧風險倡導者的擔憂，他們擔心的不是過度強大的人工智慧，而是缺乏批判性或惡意操作員所使用的粗糙系統。這篇題為「美軍因虛構的人工智慧情報報告差點登上一艘中國船隻」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。
